source: Per-building records gathered from published sources, one fact at a time, each with its source and the date it was read. Keyed by the building's Appendix B name. Nothing here comes from the 2024 SRO Tenant Survey; it is what else is known about the building.

fields.selfContained: true where the record shows the building is already self-contained apartments rather than SRO rooms
fields.storeys: storeys stated by the source, to check the LiDAR reading
fields.units: dwelling units stated by the source, against Appendix B's room count
fields.unitMix: units by type, as the source gives them
fields.facts: each fact as a sentence, with its source, link and the date read
fields.facade: a facade record taken from the street: bays, ground-floor use, cladding, top (reserved for the facade form)

facts.text: A three-storey walk-up apartment building of 52 self-contained units: 38 studios, 8 one-bedroom, 2 two-bedroom and 4 three-bedroom, 8 of them accessible.
A common room, shared laundry and an office on the main floor.
Appendix B counts 54 rooms here; the co-op's 52 units are apartments, so the by-law's conversion tests do not describe this building.
facts.source: This record against the 2024 SRO Tenant Survey, Appendix B
